turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I fixed it. Nothing in the code was filtering those tasks out. The problem was the prompts that write the recap: none of them said undated tasks count, and the Groq prompt's only example was "Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday". That taught the model an action item needs a date, so "Priya will send the contract" got dropped.

What I changed:

- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`**: this builds the recap when you end a meeting. I added a rule to the shared rules block, so it applies to both the generic recap and the mode-specific section recaps. It says any task with a person on it is an action item, gives the Priya contract line as the example, and says never to drop an item for having no date or to make one up. I also reworded the `actionItems` field to "Owner: task, with the due date if one was given, otherwise '(no date given)'".
- **`electron/llm/prompts.ts`** (`GROQ_SUMMARY_JSON_PROMPT`): I added an undated example next to the Bob one and the same "include every owned task" rule. This prompt matters most, because the recap uses it whenever Groq is the model that answers.
- **`electron/llm/tinyPrompts.ts`**: I made the same fix in the small-model recap prompt. I also changed the live Team Meet "📋 [Who] to [What] by [When]" format so it writes "no date given" instead of skipping the item.

Undated items will now show up as something like "Priya: Send the contract (no date given)".

I haven't type-checked or tested this against a real model. These are only prompt text changes, so the way to confirm it is to record a short meeting where someone says "X will do Y" with no date, end it, and check the action items.

I found the real causes. My first fix didn't reach them. Both are in `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`, and I've fixed both:

1. **The "Action Items" section was told to keep only your own tasks.** If a mode is active (Team Meet, Sales, Recruiting and others), the recap uses that mode's sections. Their stored descriptions say things like "All action items that were said **I** would do after the meeting". So "Priya will send the contract" got dropped because it's Priya's task. The missing date wasn't the issue. These descriptions are stored in your local database, so editing the default templates wouldn't change your existing modes. Instead, the recap prompt now adds a note to any section whose title includes "action", "follow-up", "next steps" or "to-do". The note says to include every task anyone took on or was given, with or without a deadline, written as "Owner: task (due date)" or "Owner: task (no date given)".

2. **The end of long meetings was cut off.** The transcript went to the model as `context.substring(0, 10000)`, roughly the first 10 minutes. The wrap-up, where people usually hand out tasks, never got read. The limit is now 60k characters. If a meeting runs longer than that, it keeps the first third and the last two thirds of that budget and drops the middle.

The prompt changes from my first pass are still there.

Two caveats:
- Action-item sections in Sales, Recruiting and Team Meet will now list other people's tasks too, not just yours. That's what your Priya example needs. If you want a mode to stay "my tasks only", I can exclude it.
- I couldn't type-check or run this. `node_modules` isn't installed and the sandbox blocked npm. Run `npm install && npx tsc --noEmit -p electron/tsconfig.json`, then record a meeting over 10 minutes where someone near the end says "X will do Y" with no date, end it, and check the recap.

If it still fails after that, tell me which mode was active and what the recap showed, and I'll look at the logs for the raw model output.

Your app hasn't run any of my changes yet. They're only in the source code in this repo, and nothing has been rebuilt:

- This repo has no `node_modules` and no build output (`dist-electron` doesn't exist).
- `/Applications/Natively.app` is dated May 10, so it's an older build.
- Your log (`~/Documents/natively_debug.log`) records the last meeting save on May 27. The app was last opened July 12, and no meeting has been saved since.

So this isn't a sign the fix failed. Any meeting you've recorded used the old prompts. The log does show the old bug, though. In the May 20 meeting, General mode returned `"Action items": []`.

To test it, run this from the repo:

```
npm install
npm start
```

That runs the dev build with the changes. `npm run dist` builds a new `.app` if you want to replace the one in Applications. I couldn't do either myself, because the sandbox blocks npm from downloading packages.

One thing to rule out: if by "recap" you mean the **Recap button** during a call, not the notes saved when you end a meeting, that's a separate feature I haven't changed. It only reads the last 120 seconds of the conversation and is cut to 5 bullets in code (`electron/llm/RecapLLM.ts`), so it will drop tasks no matter how they're worded. Tell me if that's the one you mean and I'll fix it.

If the saved notes still drop undated tasks after you run the new build, send me the time of that meeting. I'll pull the model's raw response from the log and see exactly what it returned.
